name: memolens
description: Private local photo/video-segment search and unsaved hard-cut timeline drafting for Codex, with safe-default read-only SQLite access.

interface.shortDescription: Search private media and draft unsaved hard-cut timelines.
interface.longDescription: MemoLens lets Codex search local photo and video metadata through SQLite opened read-only, read immutable timeline revisions, and draft or structurally validate Timeline 1.0 JSON entirely in memory. No third-party model API key is required. The plugin exposes no save, render, export, delete, or arbitrary-path write tool; the unauthenticated loopback API opt-in grants read features only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search my local MemoLens media library, ground selections in current analysis provenance, and draft an unsaved Timeline 1.0 plan for me to review in the desktop app.
